description: This file defines the UserRoleDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of user roles within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles rendering user role information, editing roles with permission checks, and updating roles with safeguards for admin users.

classes.name: UserRoleDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for managing user role display and editing within OrchardCore, including permission checks and role assignment logic.

methods.name: UserRoleDisplayDriver
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for user role management.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Renders user role information for display in admin views.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Provides an interface to edit user roles, with permission checks.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to user roles, adding or removing roles with safeguards for admin users.

methods.name: GetAccessibleRoleNamesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves role names that the current user is authorized to assign.
